name: Surf and paddle school

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Kai and Pono (instructors) and the beach stand
A.customer: Alex M. (a first-timer) · other surfers · a parent booking for a child

services.name: Group beginner lesson
services.story: The main story: Alex's group beginner lesson at the beach stand, $85 a person, paid in full when booking. A kids' lesson and a paddle session are paid this way too. A late cancel or a no-show: the price may be kept only with the owner's yes.

services.name: Private lesson
services.story: A private lesson at the beach: a card is saved for the $40 fee, and the lesson is paid at the stand. A late cancel or no-show: the $40 fee, only with the owner's yes.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Sol and Ines (instructors who go to a customer's place)
B.customer: Alex M. (books for a group) · the group

services.name: Private lesson at your place
services.story: The main story: a private lesson for a family of 4 at a rental house, $160, with a card saved for the $40 fee; the $160 is charged when the instructor texts DONE. A late cancel or nobody there: the $40, only with the owner's OK.

services.name: Beach party lesson
services.story: A beach party lesson for up to 6 people, $420, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: class: seats in a scheduled lesson on the beach, each surfer with their own spot and their own code; a private lesson books one instructor for one person or a family; at a customer's place (flow B) the instructor goes to the beach the group picks
questions_before_times: how many surfers, and their ages (children's lessons are for ages 8 to 12)
has the surfer tried surfing or paddling before (sets the level and the group)
for a lesson at a customer's place: the address, the beach they want and the area
safety_stop: someone not breathing or unresponsive in the water right now, or a child who can't get a breath
first_steps: Health questions on the secure page
license: none from the state for surf lessons in most places; each instructor holds a current lifeguard or first-aid card the business says is current; where a city or park permits commercial lessons on its beach, the permit is the business's own word, shown only once the owner says it is on file
staff_skills: surf and paddle lessons, kids' lessons, private lessons; the beaches each instructor knows; children's lessons only with instructors the owner says may teach children
messages_never: health notes, injuries, a child's name and age in texts to anyone but the parent: only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
